description: This Java interface defines configuration accessors for streaming-related settings in a gateway service, including methods to retrieve various timeout durations, acknowledgment configurations, websocket and SSE configs, and parallelism. It also provides a default method to render the configuration into a Typesafe Config object.

classes.name: StreamingConfig
classes.description: An interface for accessing streaming configuration parameters such as intervals, timeouts, acknowledgment settings, and associated configs.

methods.name: getSessionCounterScrapeInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval for session counter updates.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementConfig
methods.description: Returns the acknowledgment configuration for streaming sessions.

methods.name: getWebsocketConfig
methods.description: Returns the websocket configuration for streaming.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of stream elements to process in parallel.

methods.name: getSearchIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration before closing an idle search stream.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Converts the configuration settings into a Typesafe Config object.
